title: Rate Lock Commitment Extension Requests and the Status of the Appraisal Report
content:
The days a **Rate Lock Commitment** extension request asks for include settlement days for the appraisal. The days an extension request asks for include settlement days for the appraisal. These are read from the file's **Appraisal Order**: the report's completed date, the date the borrower's copy was delivered, and any delivery-timing waiver the borrower signed.

**Rule.**

- When the file's appraisal report has been completed, the borrower's copy has not been delivered and the borrower has signed no delivery-timing waiver, the copy-undelivered allowance of **2** days is added.
- When the report has not been completed, the report-outstanding allowance of **3** days is added.
- Otherwise no appraisal days are added.

| Report completed | Borrower's copy delivered | Delivery-timing waiver signed | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| No | — | — | 3 |
| Yes | No | No | 2 |
| Yes | No | Yes | 0 |
| Yes | Yes | No | 0 |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* the report was completed on 2 June and the borrower signed the waiver of the three-day appraisal delivery timing, but no copy has been delivered yet. No appraisal days are added. Without the waiver, 2 days would be added.
